breakdown.description: The setup describes a vertical bubble column with gas injected to rise along the Y-axis, but gravity is applied horizontally, which would push the bubbles sideways instead of upwards.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the incorrect gravity vector `g (-9.81 0 0)` from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires `g (0 -9.81 0)` since the column height is along the Y-direction and gravity must act downward along the negative Y-axis for bubbles to rise vertically. The agent failed to identify and correct this inconsistency.
